LAW AND MOTION 301, RULING -THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT JAMES LANGFORD RE-NOTICE OF MOTION FOR SANCTIONS IS GRANTED. PLAINTIFF'S COUNSEL HAVE PRESENTED PLEADINGS THAT VIOLATE C C P SECTION 128.7(B)(2) AND (B)(3) IN THAT PLAINTIFF FALSELY ALLEGED BEING QUALIFIED TO DO BUSINESS IN CALIFORNIA AND MAINTAINED THE SUIT IN THE FACE OF KNOWING THAT ALLEGATION WAS BOTH FALSE AND NECESSARY. PLAINTIFF'S ATTORNEYS ELTMAN, ELTMAN, COOPER AND MARK LEE JOINTLY AND SEVERALLY ARE ORDERED TO PAY TO DEFENDANT'S ATTORNEY (HANSON BRDIGETT) THE SUM OF $3,000 AS PARTIAL COMPENSATION FOR FEES INCURRED PURSUANT TO SECTION 128.7(D) TO DETER FUTURE VIOLATIONS. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL A. KAREN CSR# 8189 301/PJB

LAW AND MOTION 301, RULING - THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT JAMES LANGFORD'S MOTION TO DISMISS, OR ALTERNATIVELY, DEMURRER TO PLAINTIFF'S FIRST AMENDED COMPLAINT IS GRANTED.
